streak:title: Your streak
streak:title__note: Screen title for the streak and its protections.
streak:days: {count, plural, =0 {No days yet} one {# day} other {# days}}
streak:days__note: The current streak length, large. Plural because Swedish and German need forms English does not.
streak:longest: Longest: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
streak:longest__note: The user's record streak, shown under the current one.
streak:intact: Come back tomorrow to keep it going
streak:intact__note: Status line when the streak is alive. Encouraging, never a countdown threat.
streak:none: Finish a lesson today to start one
streak:none__note: Status line when there is no streak. Names the next step.
streak:milestone.reached: {count, plural, one {# day — that's a milestone} other {# days — that's a milestone}}
streak:milestone.reached__note: Shown on the exact day a streak reaches 7, 30, 100 or 365. Celebratory and finished — it must NOT also name the next target, because today is for arriving.
streak:milestone.next: {count, plural, one {# day to your next milestone} other {# days to your next milestone}}
streak:milestone.next__note: Days remaining until the next milestone that pays out. A thing to look forward to, never a warning — no 'don't lose it', no countdown.
streak:broken.title: Your streak ended
streak:broken.title__note: Shown when a streak has broken. Plain and calm — never 'You lost your streak!' with an alarm.
streak:broken.body: It happens. You can pick it back up today, or bring the old one back.
streak:broken.body__note: Reassurance after a break. Offers both paths and blames nobody.
streak:freeze.title: Streak freezes
streak:freeze.held__note: How many freezes the user owns. {max} is the cap.
streak:freeze.body: A freeze covers one missed day automatically. You never have to remember to use it.
streak:freeze.body__note: Explains freezes. The automatic part matters — it is not a thing to forget.
streak:freeze.buy__note: Purchase button. {price} is a coin amount.
streak:freeze.full__note: Shown instead of the buy button at the cap. Never sell something that cannot be received.
streak:freeze.refused.atCap__note: Shown when the server refuses a freeze purchase because the user is at the cap. Plain statement, no apology, no second offer.
streak:freeze.refused.funds: Not quite enough coins for that yet
streak:freeze.refused.funds__note: Shown when a freeze purchase is refused for coins. 'yet' because they will earn more; never suggest buying any.
streak:freeze.refused.failed: That didn't go through. Nothing was spent.
streak:freeze.refused.failed__note: Shown when a freeze purchase fails for any other reason. The second sentence matters most — the user needs to know their coins are safe.
streak:repair.title: Bring it back
streak:repair.buy: Restore {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} · {price}
streak:repair.buy__note: Repair button. Names exactly what is restored, so the price is judged against a real number.
streak:repair.expires: Available for {hours, plural, one {# more hour} other {# more hours}}
streak:repair.expires__note: How long the repair window stays open. Informative, not a pressure tactic — no seconds ticking.
streak:repair.cooldown: Repair is available again in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
streak:repair.cooldown__note: Why repair is unavailable. Says WHEN, so the user stops tapping.
streak:repair.expired: The window for this one has closed
streak:repair.expired__note: Why repair is unavailable after 48 hours. Final and calm.
streak:cantAfford__note: Shown when the balance is short. States the gap plainly — never 'Get more coins!' with a store link.
streak:earned: Coins come from lessons, never from money
streak:earned__note: Standing reassurance on the streak screen. This must remain TRUE — see docs/systems/xp-economy.md.
